issues.label: Rule 90.3 primary physical custody finding
issues.why: Rule 90.3 support awards require a specific finding of which parent has primary physical custody before graduation.

issues.label: Whether assisted-living child counts as parental custody
issues.why: The court must determine whether a child living in a state facility can be in a parent's primary physical custody.

issues.label: Adopting Cline's income figure for support
issues.why: The court adopted $109,249 adjusted income from Cline's proposed findings, which must be adequately supported.

issues.label: Authority for post-majority adult child support
issues.why: The court must have legal authority to order ongoing support for a disabled adult child beyond majority.

issues.label: Disabled-adult-child support standard and prerequisites
issues.why: Post-majority support for a disabled adult typically requires findings the child cannot be self-supporting and dependency persists.

issues.label: Reasonableness of $1,280 monthly expenses
issues.why: The court credited Duckett's expense testimony and must justify finding that amount reasonable and necessary.

issues.label: Equal split of ongoing support obligation
issues.why: The court split ongoing support evenly, which may conflict with income-based apportionment principles.

issues.label: Effect of Social Security benefits on support
issues.why: The court must address how anticipated Social Security benefits offset or terminate support obligations.

issues.label: Classification of $50,000 loan forgiveness
issues.why: Whether forgiving Cline's half of a marital loan created separate property depends on tracing and intent.

issues.label: Classification of $50,000 gift check
issues.why: Depositing the check into a shared account may show transmutation to marital property.

issues.label: Donative intent evidence from mother
issues.why: The court discounted the mother's testimony about intending a separate gift, which bears on classification.

issues.label: Burden of proving separate property
issues.why: Cline bore the burden to establish the inheritance was non-marital or not transmuted.

issues.label: Application of Merrill equitable division factors
issues.why: The court must properly analyze and weigh all relevant Merrill factors for the division.

issues.label: Justification for 55/45 division
issues.why: The unequal award based on earning potential and homemaker role must be supported by findings.

issues.label: Weighing earning capacity versus current income
issues.why: Duckett's re-entry to work and Cline's wage decrease affect the earning-capacity analysis.

issues.label: Treatment of Cline's $250,000 scam loss
issues.why: Whether the dissipated funds affect the estate or division must be considered.

issues.label: Ramsey post-separation credit entitlement
issues.why: Cline sought credits for separate funds preserving marital assets, requiring findings on the Ramsey factors.

issues.label: Adequacy of findings on credit request
issues.why: The court must make written findings addressing Cline's requested post-separation credits.

issues.label: Relationship of $61,690 stipulated reimbursement to credits
issues.why: The prior stipulated repair reimbursement may overlap or conflict with the requested post-separation credits.

issues.label: Allocation of capital gains tax liability
issues.why: The court must determine whether tax liability properly follows the 55/45 division or should be split otherwise.

issues.label: Failure to address issue in original order
issues.why: Capital gains taxes were omitted from the order and first resolved on reconsideration.

issues.label: Standard for reconsideration relief
issues.why: The court must apply the correct standard in denying Cline's reconsideration motion.

issues.label: Adequacy of factual findings generally
issues.why: Appellate review requires sufficiently specific findings on each contested issue.
